WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_telescopes AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes
)
SELECT 
  tc.observstation,
  tc.telescope_count,
  CAST(tc.telescope_count AS REAL) / tt.total as share
FROM telescope_counts tc
CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
